items.title: 2026 Iran war: Hormuz shipping still ~65% below pre-war levels
items.content: By mid-November 2026, commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz remained roughly 65 percent below pre-war levels, with 136 maritime security incidents recorded since the conflict began. On 15 November the IRGC reported a six-drone strike on a US air defense radar at Riffa Air Base in Bahrain; Bahrain intercepted multiple incoming Iranian drones after two public shelter-in-place alerts.

items.title: Strait of Hormuz crisis: Iran seeks control and transit fees despite June MoU
items.content: Despite the June 2026 memorandum of understanding aimed at reopening the Strait of Hormuz and ending the Iran war, Iran has sought to assert hegemonic control over the strait and eventually collect fees on ships passing through. The strait has become the central flashpoint of the US-Iran conflict since February 2026.

items.title: US stocks: Dow 52,307; S&P 500 still ~2.9% below October record
items.content: The Dow Jones gained 10 points (0.02%) on Friday 13 November to close at 52,307 points. The S&P 500 closed at 7,592.40 on Thursday 12 November, down 0.35% and 2.90% below its record of 7,818.93 set on 6 October 2026. The index had fallen 4.36% on 5 November, its biggest one-day drop since April 2025.

items.title: Hang Seng falls 1.26% to 24,008.55 as Alibaba leads tech retreat
items.content: The Hang Seng Index closed at 24,008.55 points on Thursday 12 November 2026, down 307.37 points or 1.26% from Wednesday's close of 24,315.92, with Alibaba leading a retreat in technology names. The HSI is down about 12.7% year on year.

items.title: US PCE inflation 3.6% YoY in September, core 3.4%
items.content: The PCE price index annual change rose to 3.60% in September 2026 from 3.40% in August, well above the Fed's 2% target and above target every year since 2021. Core PCE was 3.4% YoY. The next PCE release is scheduled for 25 November 2026.

items.title: China AI stocks plunge while domestic chipmakers surge
items.content: Chinese AI-related stocks fell sharply on fears of tighter US export restrictions, while domestic semiconductor names rallied: SMIC gained 2.4% in Shanghai and 1.7% in Hong Kong, Hua Hong rose 2.7%, NAURA advanced 3.1%, Cambricon surged more than 11% and Moore Threads around 7%. An index tracking semiconductor and AI businesses has shed roughly 40% of its value in four months.

items.title: Week ahead earnings: Nvidia on Tuesday, Home Depot and Walmart also report
items.content: Nvidia reports on Tuesday 17-18 November, its first results since Jensen Huang stepped down; the call is expected to clarify how the company proceeds without his leadership. Home Depot consensus is EPS of $3.84 (+2.7% YoY) on revenue of $42.8bn (+3.4%), with Walmart and other major retailers also reporting this week.

items.title: Hong Kong Q3 GDP up 5.2% YoY, first three quarters up 5.1%
items.content: Hong Kong's real GDP rose 5.2% year on year in Q3 2026. For the first three quarters combined real GDP grew 5.1%, the fastest pace in five years for the corresponding period, supported by robust global AI-related demand. The government expects a strong full-year performance.

items.title: 胡塞武装称向沙特利雅得发射弹道导弹，并袭击东西向输油管道泵站
items.content: 也门胡塞武装 11 月 15 日声称使用弹道导弹打击了沙特首都利雅得的哈立德国王国际机场和一座金融中心，另以无人机袭击了沙特东西向输油管道的两座泵站，声称达成预定目标。沙特主导联军过去 24 小时对也门多省发动 75 次空袭和导弹袭击。

items.title: 一艘油轮在霍尔木兹海峡以东触雷后起火
items.content: 伊朗海军称，一艘油轮在霍尔木兹海峡以东触雷后起火。该海峡商业航运量仍显著低于战前水平，能源运输风险与保险成本持续上升。

items.title: CME：美联储 12 月加息 25 个基点概率 95%
items.content: 据 CME“美联储观察”，美联储 12 月加息 25 个基点的概率为 95%，加息 50 个基点概率 5%。到明年 1 月累计加息 50 个基点的概率为 71.1%。

items.title: 英伟达风波冲击全球算力格局，国产算力有望迎来重估契机
items.content: 黄仁勋辞任英伟达总裁、首席执行官及董事会成员，结束 33 年掌舵生涯。消息公布后英伟达股价盘中一度暴跌超 14%，收盘跌 4.34%，市值 7 月以来首次跌破 4 万亿美元。市场认为国产算力链有望获得重估。

items.title: 美财长贝森特：下个月美国通胀将大幅下降
items.content: 美财长贝森特表示，下个月美国通胀将大幅下降，并对美联储喊话“向前看，不要盯着后视镜”。与此同时，堪萨斯城联储主席称撇开能源价格通胀仍运行在 3%，官方与市场对通胀路径分歧扩大。
